title: Default research progression keeps paper readiness as the mainline, not support work
failureMode: Auto/default progression shrank the task to provenance, validation, or artifact cleanup instead of advancing the paper toward submit-ready scientific content.

quotes: Dove 的核心目标：主要是推进科研正文本身达到可提交水平，而不是把证据整理、补充包、provenance、validation 或其他支撑工作提升成独立主线。

surface.prompt: 继续推进当前主线，目标是让论文更接近可提交。

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The first substantive action is anchored on the current paper and its scientific readiness, not provenance or package cleanup.
failureSignals: It makes provenance, validation, or Markdown maintenance the main objective.
It treats support artifacts as completion evidence.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The actual manuscript is inspected and, if feasible, materially improved or diagnosed.
failureSignals: It reports next steps without inspecting paper/main.tex.
It only edits a working note.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The answer separates scientific readiness from lower-level artifact checks.
failureSignals: It declares ready because files exist or local checks passed.
It ignores the contribution/result connection gap.
